## Components implemented
| Area | Component | Module |
|---|---|---|
| Data | long-CSV parsing, ID validation, duplicate/conflict handling, fractional-value preservation, `any` consistency, label report | `src/data/csv_parser.py` |
| Data | restartable chunked DICOM header scan, slice ordering by orientation-aware position, integrity report | `src/data/dicom_metadata.py` |
| Data | patient-level stratified split, study fallback, leakage verification, manifest hash, save/load with verification | `src/data/splitting.py` |
| Data | HU conversion, RSNA 12-bit intercept fix, MONOCHROME1, windows, pad-to-square, resize, normalisation, fingerprint | `src/data/preprocessing.py` |
| Data | on-demand dataset, bounded LRU + bounded atomic disk cache, CT augmentation, unlabelled competition-test dataset, feature dataset | `src/data/dataset.py` |
| Track A | timm Transformer factory with weight-status records (download / local file / fallback / failed) | `src/models/transformers.py` |
| Track B | CNN-Transformer hybrid with fusion ablations and attention output | `src/models/cnn_transformer.py` |
| Track C | VQC layer (torch exact simulator + PennyLane backend), resources, simulator benchmark, diagnostics | `src/quantum/*` |
| Track C | matched heads: linear probe, MLP, bottleneck-identity, bottleneck-MLP, VQC | `src/models/hybrid_classifier.py` |
| Training | weighted BCE / focal loss, trainer (AMP, accumulation, clipping, cosine/plateau, early stopping, resume, history), checkpoint guards | `src/training/*` |
| Orchestration | experiment runners (image, features, heads), validation-only selection, model reload | `src/training/experiment.py` |
| Evaluation | six-label metrics with explicit NaN reasons, val-only frozen thresholds, patient-cluster bootstrap, paired bootstrap, Holm, DeLong, seed statistics, study aggregation, Grad-CAM, plots, submission | `src/evaluation/*` |
| Utils | YAML modes/overrides, dataset discovery, runtime detection + OOM probe, project context (per-mode outputs, attached-input discovery, restore), registry, atomic I/O | `src/utils/*` |

## Tests executed (locally) and results
| Check | Command | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Unit tests | `python -m pytest tests -q` | **60 passed**, 0 failed, 0 skipped (PennyLane installed, so the backend-equivalence tests ran) |
| Static validation | `python tools/validate_project.py` | `all_ok = true` (47 .py files compile, 37 modules import, 4 configs × 3 modes, 6 notebooks valid with no stored outputs) |
| End-to-end notebooks (synthetic DICOMs, smoke mode, random-init backbones, competition inference enabled) | `python tools/run_notebooks_synthetic.py --work <dir>` | **6/6 executed, 0 error outputs**; a valid submission CSV was produced from the synthetic test folder |
| Pretrained weights (download) | build DeiT-Small + EfficientNet-B0 stem with `pretrained=True` | status `pretrained` (verified) |
| Pretrained weights (offline local file) | `build_backbone("deit_small", weights_dir=...)` | status `pretrained_local_file`, weights identical to the hub weights |
| VQC torch vs PennyLane | max abs. difference of outputs and gradients (4 qubits, all entanglement modes, with/without re-uploading) | ≤ 1.7e-6 |

What the unit tests cover: label parsing (malformed, duplicate, conflicting, fractional, `any` consistency, all conflict policies),
header-scan integrity (missing and corrupt files) and restartability, orientation-aware slice position, patient split without overlap,
leakage detection, study fallback, manifest hash save/load/tamper detection, split reproducibility, patient-level subsetting, windowing,
the RSNA intercept fix, DICOM → channels, preprocessing fingerprint, dataset items with disk/memory cache, decode-failure handling,
unlabelled competition-test dataset, augmentation determinism, config modes/overrides, dataset discovery, shared-module imports,
ProjectContext mode isolation/artifact discovery/restore, registry (including a torn last line), the CNOT truth table, an analytic
single-qubit expectation, torch-vs-PennyLane equivalence (outputs + input and weight gradients), VQC forward/backward and resources,
autocast isolation, all five feature heads, parameter matching of the classical control, DeiT/Swin/MaxViT forward passes,
weight-fallback records, the CNN-Transformer hybrid (3 fusion modes), checkpoint round-trip/manifest guard/overwrite guard, trainer
fit/early completion/resume from `last.pt`, prediction serialisation, Grad-CAM (CNN and token layouts), runtime detection, metrics
vs scikit-learn, undefined-metric NaNs, confusion counts, val-only thresholds, cluster bootstrap and paired bootstrap, Holm, DeLong,
seed summary, study aggregation, the RSNA log loss, and the submission format.

## Tests that could not be performed
* Any run on the real RSNA data (not available locally; ~459 GB).
* Any run on Kaggle hardware or the Kaggle filesystem (no Kaggle execution access from this environment).
* Full-length training or multi-epoch convergence behaviour on realistic data.
* Pretrained downloads for Swin-Tiny and MaxViT-Tiny. They use the same timm code path as DeiT-Small, which was verified.
* Compressed-DICOM decoding (synthetic files are uncompressed).

## Known failures
* None outstanding in the local checks.
* Fixed during development and kept as regression coverage: corrupt files read with `force=True` were initially reported as readable
  (now detected); a DataLoader-worker pickling error on spawn platforms (locks and a lambda in the dataset; now picklable); a Windows
  default-encoding error when writing the circuit drawing (all text writes now use UTF-8); a non-hex synthetic test ID.

## Unresolved issues / open risks
* Kaggle header-scan throughput for 752k files is unknown (restartable by design).
* No 2×T4 data parallelism.
* Full-mode training time per model on Kaggle is unknown. Plan for several sessions using the resume mechanism.
